name: math-render-fix
description: Keeps math readable in ZCode chat: SessionStart and Stop hooks steer the model to dollar-delimited formulas and re-output any written with \(...\) or \[...\], and an optional command patches the renderer so those delimiters display too.

description_i18n.en: Keeps math readable in ZCode chat: SessionStart and Stop hooks steer the model to dollar-delimited formulas and re-output any written with \(...\) or \[...\], and an optional command patches the renderer so those delimiters display too.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 ZCode 聊天界面的数学公式正常显示：SessionStart 与 Stop 两个 Hook 引导模型使用美元符分界符，并把 \(...\) 或 \[...\] 写法的公式重新输出；另有一个可选命令给渲染层打补丁，让这两种写法也能直接显示。
